{{Taurus}}
Taurus 17 is the 157th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 17th day of Taurus, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 23, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 6宮17日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 157|Chapter 157]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152177}}.
